captures.note: app script of the site as fetched for the HN post of 18 Oct (salvo hn news-posts, file mtime 21 Oct; 215 run records)

agent: converter convert.py (Sonnet 5.5), from the saved JS of the site

extractions.tool: convert.py (this folder): the JSON array of run records embedded in the script as JSON.parse('[...]') (the first such literal), written unchanged (215 records)

convert.py (this folder): one row per (model id, agent) of the run records: runs = their number, passed_of_runs = records with status "passed" / runs, cost_mean = mean of total_cost_usd (4 decimals), first_start / last_finish = the earliest started_at / latest finished_at, caps = counts of the statuses timeout_exceeded and budget_exceeded, budget = budget_usd. Derived cells: the site computes pass rate in the browser

tables.where: derived per-model cells of the run records

facts.value: Score combines pass rate, cost, and code size
facts.where: Leaderboard heading of the site: the leaderboard score combines pass rate, cost and code size (the board's own score is not a held metric)
facts.quote: Score combines pass rate, cost, and code size

facts.where: field total_cost_usd of every run record
column cost_mean: mean of total_cost_usd over the runs of the model and agent
